title: Rosewood Sora Skybar Experience
description: Take in panoramic river views from Sora Skybar on the 37th floor of Rosewood Phnom Penh. High-altitude cocktails and world-class luxury nightlife.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Rosewood Sora Skybar, located on the 37th floor of the Vattanac Capital Tower in Phnom Penh, offers panoramic views of the Mekong River and the confluence of the Tonle Sap and Mekong rivers. This ultra-luxurious venue provides a sophisticated nightlife experience, featuring world-class mixology and high-end Japanese tapas.
> * AGS offers priority booking, skip-the-line access via express elevator, and luxury private SUV transfers to Sora, ensuring a seamless 2-3 hour experience. This service bypasses logistical friction, guaranteeing access to premium sunset tables and aligning with the venue's "glamorous, high-altitude, sophisticated" atmosphere.
> * Sora represents a significant modernization of Phnom Penh's nightlife, shifting from ground-level bars to high-altitude luxury. It is open year-round, requires advance booking, and is best paired as a Friday night capstone to a Phnom Penh visit, with a smart casual dress code.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Command panoramic views of the Mekong River from the 37th floor of the Vattanac Capital Tower. Sora is the undisputed, ultra-luxurious peak of Phnom Penh's modern nightlife.

## The Operator & Origin Story
The opening of the Rosewood Hotel fundamentally shifted Phnom Penh's nightlife from ground-level riverside bars to high-altitude luxury. Sora represents the rapid, striking modernization of the Cambodian capital.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Pre-empt the heavy walk-in queue with AGS priority booking. You are escorted via express elevator to the cantilevered terrace protruding perilously over the city grid. 

Secure a premium sunset table facing the confluence of the Tonle Sap and Mekong rivers. The experience is defined by world-class mixology, high-end Japanese tapas, and a sophisticated, affluent crowd. Dress to impress; this is the apex of modern Khmer glamour.

## The Ultimate 37th-Floor 19th Hole Above Vattanac Capital Tower in Phnom Penh
Cantilevered dramatically from the 37th floor of the dragon-inspired Vattanac Capital Tower in the heart of Phnom Penh, **Sora Skybar at [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/)** shares the exact same Vattanac corporate pedigree as Sir Nick Faldo’s 36-hole masterpiece at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/). For golf groups staying directly inside [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) or 5 minutes away at [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/) during [The Khmer Kingdom Links](/tours/the-khmer-kingdom-links/), ascending the express elevator to Sora after playing the [Vattanac East Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-east/), [Vattanac West Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/), or [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/) is the undisputed highlight of a Phnom Penh golf evening.

## Cantilevered Terrace Tables, Malt Library & Dress Code
* **Front-Row Mekong Confluence Tables:** Outdoor terrace tables along the cantilevered ledge book out days in advance; Asia Golf Specialists locks in sunset or post-dinner edge seating overlooking the Royal Palace and the meeting of the Mekong and Tonle Sap rivers.
* **Bespoke Mixology & Single-Malt Whisky Vault:** Beyond Sora’s Japanese-inspired Izakaya small plates and architectural cocktails, golf groups can book a private tasting inside Rosewood’s adjacent whisky and cigar lounge, featuring rare Japanese and Scottish single malts.
* **Strictly Enforced Smart-Casual Attire:** Sora enforces closed-toe shoes, tailored trousers, and collared shirts for gentlemen after 5:00 PM—no golf sandals, athletic shorts, or sleeveless shirts are permitted on the 37th floor.

## Integrating Sora Skybar Into Your Phnom Penh Golf & Dining Schedule
For travelers staying in-house at [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) or transferring 8 minutes from [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/), Sora Skybar anchors the evening after a morning tee time at [Vattanac East Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-east/), [Vattanac West Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/), [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/), or [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/). Groups frequently begin on the cantilevered 37th-floor terrace at 5:30 PM for sunset cocktails over the Mekong confluence before stepping one floor up to *Cuts* on the 38th floor for dry-aged Wagyu and a post-round bottle of Bordeaux.

faqs.q: How is Sora Skybar connected to Vattanac Golf Resort in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Both Rosewood Phnom Penh (home to Sora Skybar on the 37th floor of Vattanac Capital Tower) and Vattanac Golf Resort (Sir Nick Faldo's 36-hole East and West championship courses 40 minutes away) are flagship properties of the Vattanac Group.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for golfers visiting Sora Skybar at Rosewood Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Sora enforces a smart-casual dress code from 5:00 PM onward: men must wear collared shirts, tailored trousers or dark denim, and closed-toe leather shoes or dress sneakers (no flip-flops, golf sandals, or athletic shorts).

faqs.q: What time should we reserve a terrace table at Sora Skybar after playing golf in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: After a morning round at Vattanac Golf Resort or Chhun On Golf Resort, we recommend a 5:30 PM reservation on Sora's cantilevered terrace to catch sunset over the Mekong confluence before dinner at Cuts or Brasserie Louis.
